title: Review Decision Timeframes and Reviewer Levels — Utilization Management Program
content:
The clinical review desk of the Utilization Management Program works to the following service terms, set per review package.

## Timeframes and urgency

| Review package | Standard review decided within (hours from receipt of the case) | Urgent review decided within (hours from receipt) | Urgent only on prescriber attestation | Request filed as urgent without attestation may be handled as standard | Urgent reviews taken and decided around the clock, weekends and holidays included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 72 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 72 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 72 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 72 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 72 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 72 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The prescriber attestation is that the standard timeframe could seriously jeopardize the member's life, health or ability to regain maximum function.

## Missing information, reviewers and decisions

| Review package | Outreach attempts to the prescriber for missing clinical information | Calendar days to wait after the information request (request date as day zero) | Lowest reviewer who may approve | Urgent denial needs a physician reviewer | A case takes exactly one decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 2 | 7 | pharmacist | No | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 2 | 7 | pharmacist | No | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 3 | 5 | pharmacist | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 3 | 5 | pharmacist | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 3 | 3 | pharmacist | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 3 | 3 | pharmacist | Yes | Yes |

Denials are always made by a pharmacist or a physician on every package; where the last table says Yes, an urgent denial needs a physician.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a standard case received at 09:00 on a Monday is due for decision by 09:00 on the Thursday, 72 hours later; an urgent case received at the same moment is due by 09:00 on the Tuesday.
